title: VAC14 oligomerization is essential for the function of the FAB1/PIKfyve-VAC14-FIG4 complex.
summary: AlphaFold2 plus cryo-EM maps identified VAC14 assembly interfaces; yeast and human-cell functional assays tested their importance. Basic disease-mechanism evidence, not a demonstrated treatment.
organization: University of Michigan; Yale University; University of Ottawa
